name: Review Sort / Filter Bar
summary: Container-responsive labelled review-control group that composes canonical Select and Button or link without defining result behavior.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Container-responsive group for target-owned review-list controls; its historical class name does not imply the ARIA toolbar widget pattern.

anatomy.name: controlGroup
anatomy.description: Optional structural wrapper for a target-owned ordering or filtering control.

anatomy.name: select
anatomy.description: Optional composed Select; its label, options, enhancement, validation, and disabled state remain canonical Select concerns.

anatomy.name: nativeSelectHook
anatomy.description: Containment-only hook for the native Select fallback; no field visuals are owned here.

anatomy.name: writeAction
anatomy.description: Optional composed Button or link for a target-owned review-entry destination or action.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Optional accessible group name when surrounding context does not already identify the related controls.

properties.name: control
properties.description: Optional canonical Select or other accepted native review-list control; option meaning, current value and list effects are not defined here.

properties.name: writeAction
properties.description: Optional Button or link composition; the target decides whether it navigates, reveals in-page content, or invokes another flow.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic group that stacks and stretches composed controls when its own container is narrow.

states.name: default
states.description: Structural group state; composed controls own their interaction states.

behavior.name: keyboardBoundary
behavior.description: The root uses group semantics and normal sequential Tab order. It does not implement roving tabindex or toolbar arrow-key navigation; every child retains its native keyboard model.

behavior.name: controlBoundary
behavior.description: Select or the target owns current/default value, option inventory, ordering or filtering meaning, URL synchronization, result updates, focus retention, and announcements.

behavior.name: actionBoundary
behavior.description: The optional action preserves Button or native-link semantics; Review Toolbar does not decide whether it navigates or opens a form.

behavior.name: containerResponse
behavior.description: Composed controls share a row when the root container permits and stack at full width when the root container is narrow; the browser viewport is not the responsive source.

behavior.name: emptyComposition
behavior.description: Targets omit the complete component when neither optional slot is supplied instead of rendering an empty named group or decorative rule.

accessibility: Use role group with an accessible name when surrounding context does not already identify the related controls.
Do not use the ARIA toolbar role unless a target deliberately implements the complete roving-focus and arrow-key widget pattern for at least three appropriate controls.
Preserve the composed Select label, native fallback, focus, disabled, and validation semantics.
Preserve Button semantics and use an anchor when the write-review affordance is navigation.
When a target updates the review list in place, preserve focus and announce meaningful result changes outside this layout contract.

web.notes: Canonical CSS owns container-responsive layout and containment only; group semantics and composed controls preserve native Tab order and child-owned visual states.

shopify.notes: A future provider theme app block must supply allowed controls, result lifecycle and write-review behavior while consuming generated CSS.
